articles.title: Live coverage: NASA to roll its SLS rocket back to the launch pad ahead of planned April flight of Artemis 2
articles.summary: The rollout of the 322-foot-tall rocket is anticipated to take about 12 hours after first motion. NASA hopes to launch the crewed test flight to the Moon no earlier than April 1.
